meta.name: nft-standards
meta.description: Implement NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) with proper metadata handling, minting strategies, and marketplace integration. Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发行 NFT 数字资产并接入交易市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发区块链上的 NFT 项目。
copy.tagline_en: Launch NFT digital assets and integrate with marketplaces.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building NFT projects on blockchain.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能写 ERC-721 与 ERC-1155 的 NFT 合约,涵盖铸造逻辑、IPFS 或链上元数据、EIP-2981 版税,并给出可参考的合约模板代码。
howto.when: 当你要创建 NFT 合约、搭建 NFT 交易市场,或实现数字资产系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 ERC-721 NFT 合约,带铸造上限
say.note: 产出含铸造与元数据处理的合约代码

say.text: 用 ERC-1155 写一个游戏道具合约,支持批量铸造
say.note: 产出多代币标准合约,含 mintBatch

say.text: 给我的 NFT 合约加上 EIP-2981 版税,费率 5%
say.note: 产出实现 royaltyInfo 的合约代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes ERC-721 and ERC-1155 NFT contracts with minting logic, IPFS or on-chain metadata, and EIP-2981 royalties, plus reference templates.
howto.when_en: Use it when creating NFT contracts, building an NFT marketplace, or implementing digital asset systems.

say_en.text: Write me an ERC-721 NFT contract with a mint cap.
say_en.note: Returns contract code with minting and metadata handling.

say_en.text: Build an ERC-1155 game-item contract that supports batch minting.
say_en.note: Returns a multi-token contract with mintBatch.

say_en.text: Add EIP-2981 royalties to my NFT contract at 5%.
